scope: Final P5 acceptance keeps two provenance lines separate. The Agent-owned R12 discovery experiment on 999d753 reduced repository observations from 203 to 8 and lawfully abstained because it did not prove the external no-Tool failure causally. Afterwards, independent closeout release acceptance exposed a different pre-existing Provider concurrency defect: the unique physical Provider dispatch winner could lose the generic Run lease to a non-dispatching contender and fail to commit a known result, leaving durable DISPATCHING state. Deterministic baseline-red, high-intensity reproduction, a partial-fix falsifier, bounded outcome-lease hardening, 100/100 official concurrency repetitions, 29 focused tests and 344-test full acceptance validate the source repair at 89fc499. This does not retroactively claim that the discovery Agent found or authorized that defect.
